title: Prove the sharp 240-return minimum in the frozen p2 oracle model
body:
This scoped negative result proves that the frozen p2 caller needs **exactly 240 new returns** in the enlarged arbitrary-linear-oracle model, for every width f >= 72. It closes the previous 225–240 gap. The original paid inputs, all 39 observations, ordinary algebra, capacities and targets stay fixed; feedback between new returns is allowed. Complete kappa is unchanged. This settles the return-count optimization in this contract and directs productive caller work to a changed contract.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4d112aaf8e8760d34015f934ab8a63d2b9ccda83/research/p2-exact-oracle-repair/PROOF.md), [exact verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4d112aaf8e8760d34015f934ab8a63d2b9ccda83/research/p2-exact-oracle-repair/verify.py), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4d112aaf8e8760d34015f934ab8a63d2b9ccda83/research/p2-exact-oracle-repair/RESULT.json), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/4d112aaf8e8760d34015f934ab8a63d2b9ccda83/research/p2-exact-oracle-repair/SOURCES.json). Base: canonical main 6cf7a683f447b9f1e2333791907fd92be5009a63, priority 7. Consumed [PR #5587](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5587) is pinned to [its proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/49811a9a37cc1b71bcbe851dd20da3cbf479ff35/research/p2-full-history-deficit/PROOF.md) at 49811a9a37cc1b71bcbe851dd20da3cbf479ff35.

The new second-moment certificate is 27/343 for each of the two intersection losses. It gives a complete target deficit of at least (82266/343)|H| > 239|H|. Every return supplies at most |H| dimensions, while the credited 240-return oracle construction attains the integer bound. An invertible row-space rescaling is used only in the rank proof; it does not add a free physical division by 11.

Normal and optimized registered checks pass. They check the pinned involution, full exact projector identities, balanced row spaces, all 12432 ordered off-diagonal product classes and 213248 independent signed basis actions. Direct pair-group summation agrees with the closed second moment. Four defective controls reject. Committed-byte, export-integrity and Git-free optimized replay checks pass.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p2-exact-oracle-repair
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Expected markers: `PASS_P2_EXACT_ORACLE_REPAIR_240` and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`.

The source full-history deficit and oracle upper construction, and [PR #5526](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5526) pointwise Clifford faithfulness, remain credited premises. Their full scientific replays were not run here. This is not a native 240-call supplier. No physical compiler, selected cold replay, complete kappa calculation, full source-history ancestry or independent human/formal review was run. The checkout is shallow; hosted CI is separate. The earlier source tariff obstruction already excluded this caller; this contribution settles its exact oracle repair count.

Credit Dugongue's [PR #4948](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4948) native source; Chris R / Clear1nsight's [PR #4978](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4978) D-left audit and clarifications; Ali Romman's linked history and faithfulness proofs and [PR #5449](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5449) history formulation; and josecarlosgonzalezroque-design's [PR #5570](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5570) bridge audit. Retain Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis, DLamdata, zxv and their native/controller/Clifford/interval lineage recorded in the pinned source proof. Projection moments and the product rank inequality are classical. [Coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5583#discussioncomment-19184961).
